description: Use when a visitor wants a shareable video-maker link for a historical map over a year range. An optional bbox frames the region; choose a 6-, 10- or 15-second duration and border or event layers. Returns the prefilled link, frame years and download instructions. The visitor renders the watermarked clip in their browser. For a lookup at a single year, use world_at_year.

bbox.description: Area to frame [west, south, east, north] in degrees. Default: Europe and the Mediterranean.

from_year.description: Year. Negative is BC: -500 = 500 BC. There is no year 0.

labels.description: Map labels drawn at fixed points in every frame.

lang.description: Site language for returned page and map links. Use the language the user is writing in.

layers.description: Select borders or event layers such as conflict, volcano or quake. Merged borders require borders.

title.description: Text burned into the top of the video.

to_year.description: Year. Negative is BC: -500 = 500 BC. There is no year 0.

name: create_video_link
